dialogue.text: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.
dialogue.ja: 雨水は、その時期を知っています。
dialogue.local: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.
dialogue.en: Rainwater, the rain knows its time.

dialogue.text: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.
dialogue.zh: 春天開始後，雨水節氣大約在二月十九日。
dialogue.ja: 春の始まりの後、雨水は2月19日頃に訪れます。
dialogue.local: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.
dialogue.en: After start of spring, rainwater comes around February 19th.

dialogue.text: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.
dialogue.zh: 雪融化成雨，雨水輕輕滋潤大地。
dialogue.ja: 雪が雨に変わり、雨は優しく大地を濡らします。
dialogue.local: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.
dialogue.en: Snow turns to rain, and the rain gently wets the earth.

dialogue.text: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.
dialogue.zh: 農夫很高興，雨水幫助作物生長。
dialogue.ja: 農家は喜び、雨は作物の成長を助けます。
dialogue.local: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.
dialogue.en: Farmers are happy, the rain helps their crops grow.

dialogue.text: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.
dialogue.zh: 正如詩人走過道路，良好的雨水知道正確的季節。
dialogue.ja: 詩人が道を歩くように、良い雨は適切な季節を知っています。
dialogue.local: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.
dialogue.en: As the poet do through road, good rain knows the right season.

dialogue.text: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.
dialogue.zh: 它隨著夜風悄悄來臨，默默滋養萬物。
dialogue.ja: 夜風に乗って忍び込み、静かにすべてを養います。
dialogue.local: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.
dialogue.en: It sneaks in with the night wind, quietly nourishing everything.

dialogue.text: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.
dialogue.zh: 河流在結冰後開始再次流動。
dialogue.ja: 凍っていた川が再び流れ始めます。
dialogue.local: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.
dialogue.en: Rivers start to flow again after being frozen.

dialogue.text: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.
dialogue.zh: 在某些地方，人們帶著禮物回到父母家。
dialogue.ja: ある場所では、人々が贈り物を持って実家に帰ります。
dialogue.local: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.
dialogue.en: In some places, people return to their parents' home with gifts.

dialogue.text: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
dialogue.zh: 雨水提醒我們，溫柔的事物往往最有力量。
dialogue.ja: 雨水は、優しいものが最も力強いことを思い出させてくれます。
dialogue.local: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
dialogue.en: Rainwater reminds us gentle things can be the most powerful.
